objective: Let a local product owner promote one accepted Signal into one immutable prioritized Product Issue with explicit rationale and preserved Feedback and Signal lineage.
scope: Add the Product Issues bounded context and signal-to-issue workflow.
Create one immutable Product Issue only from a currently accepted Signal at an exact expected revision.
Persist unique Signal lineage, manual priority, rationale, unverified operator label, and source Signal revision in PostgreSQL.
Add POST /api/v1/signals/{signalId}/product-issue and the additive productIssue Signal-detail projection.
Expose manual promotion and the persisted Product Issue through the local product interface.
Apply existing acknowledgement, input-bound, restricted-content, privacy, and fail-closed storage rules.
Produce ordered Foundation, Component, Integration, Workflow, and Stress evidence without advancing past a failed level.
non_goals: Automatic prioritization, probabilistic inference, feedback grouping, deduplication, or synthesis.
Product Issue editing, deletion, status workflow, assignment, implementation tracking, or release communication.
Authentication, authorization, verified identity, tenancy, shared hosting, staging, production, deployment, merge, or release.
Elder infrastructure not required by a reproduced SD-002 blocker, Gate G continuation, L2 promotion, or L3 work.
session_boundary: Stop when SD-002 is verified at the Git authorization boundary or when one reproduced product or Elder blocker is verified; do not begin another slice or gate.
evidence_plan: Foundation: validate the SD-002 ADR, contract, work item, Prisma schema, migration, source layout, dependency boundaries, types, lint, and closed route surface.
Component: prove deterministic Product Issue validation, acknowledgement, priority and text bounds, restricted-content rejection, and explicit eligibility errors.
Integration: prove accepted-state and revision eligibility, source row locking, one Signal to one immutable Product Issue, exact lineage, duplicate rejection, and transaction rollback in PostgreSQL.
Workflow: use only the local UI to create and accept a Signal, promote it to a prioritized Product Issue, inspect lineage, reload, and observe persistence at desktop and mobile widths.
Stress: prove concurrent promotion has one winner, stale and non-accepted promotion fail closed, database outage and recovery are explicit, and submitted issue content is absent from logs.
Delivery: attempt the existing Elder supervised path to a reviewable PR and record every human intervention and exact blocker.
